title: Work Map Autofix exact-head convergence contract

phases.objective: Keep the sole governed Work Map writer exact-head bound while making one writer commit converge both generated Work Maps and the two Spec014 registry bindings derived from their final registry fingerprint before post-write verification is dispatched.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The current E2E Work Map recovery bridge, Spec Kit Work Map Autofix workflow, governed generated-artifact refresh authority, canonical Spec014 final binding producer, and their pipeline/automation-overlap contracts
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives deterministic evidence only when the exact-head writer regenerates Work Maps, refreshes Hostinger and Retail Spec014 bindings from the same final registry, proves the combined write set idempotent/current, pushes once without force, and dispatches verification for the resulting exact head.
steps: Load the current E2E Work Map recovery bridge, sole workflow-dispatch writer, and registered generated-artifact refresh maintenance authority.
Validate branch/head identity, protected-ref rejection, recovery delegation, shared concurrency, self-hosting source scope, and no-force-push boundaries.
Run Work Map generation followed by the existing Spec014 binding producer for Hostinger and Retail.
Restrict the candidate delta to docs/work-maps plus the producer-owned Hostinger integration manifest/tasks and Retail integration manifest.
Repeat both generators and compare the complete bounded diff to prove combined idempotency.
Run Work Map currentness plus both Spec014 binding checks before commit/push.
Run Pipeline Connectivity, Automation Overlap, Supervisor Runtime Assurance, generated-artifact maintenance authority, and Spec014 binding convergence regressions against the same repository tree.
assertions: Work Map Autofix remains the sole remote writer for docs/work-maps and does not gain a pull_request trigger.
The one-time work-map-autofix authorization marker remains outside the writer in the recovery bridge.
The writer is bound to one existing same-repository PR branch and immutable expected_head_sha; main and Production remain forbidden targets.
Hostinger and Retail Spec014 bindings are refreshed only through http-generic-api/scripts/spec014-refresh-final-work-map-binding.mjs after Work Map generation.

The generated-artifact self-hosting source scope explicitly permits the canonical Spec014 binding regression, and the bootstrap runs that strict regression only after Work Map and both Spec014 bindings have converged and passed currentness checks, while unrelated source paths remain fail-closed.

The writer accepts no changed paths outside docs/work-maps, specs/014-governed-hostinger-storage-orchestration/work-map-integration.json, optional canonical Hostinger tasks.md, and specs/014-retail-commerce-operations-growth-os/work-map-integration.json.
Combined Work Map plus Spec014 binding generation is idempotent and both producers pass check mode before any commit.
The remote branch is re-read against expected_head_sha immediately before one normal push; force push remains forbidden.
Post-write CI and Spec Kit Work Map Integration are dispatched only for the resulting exact head.
The binding producer performs no provider dispatch, live database access, migration apply, Production mutation, or secret access.

phases.objective: Observe the next explicitly authorized Work Map Autofix dispatch and confirm the resulting exact-head Work Map integration passes without a separate Spec014 registry-binding repair cycle.
